advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test: with deploy-backoff open for $TARGET and NO pending bot delta, the tick must NOT emit 'review-bot backoff active' and must proceed to the success footer as a genuine no-op.
evidence: autodeploy.sh added block: 'if changed_range "$bot_deployed" "$TARGET" "$BOT_PATHS" || changed_range ... then / if bot_backoff_active; then log "review-bot backoff active ..."'

Diff message: 'The gate also tested backoff BEFORE the delta, so it reported a backoff skip on ticks with no bot work at all. Reversed: test the delta first, consult the window only when there is something to deploy.'

test_bot_backoff_tick_does_not_record_the_bot_as_deployed drives a BOT-only pending change (a delta IS present) plus an open window; grep shows the only three 'backoff active' assertions (lines 1260, 1300, 1372) all occur with a delta pending, so the no-delta+open-window case is never exercised.

Named violating input: deploy-backoff open for $TARGET, git stub reporting NO change under BOT_PATHS/SECRETS_PATHS (bot already at target) — under the reverted ordering the script logs a spurious 'review-bot backoff active' skip; no test asserts its absence.
advisory.finding: The deliberate gate reordering (test the bot delta FIRST, consult the backoff window only when a delta is pending) has no regression test for its exact motivating case: a tick with an OPEN bot-backoff window but NO pending bot delta. All 'backoff active' assertions run with a delta present, so reverting the order back to backoff-before-delta (which the diff says spuriously 'reported a backoff skip on ticks with no bot work at all') would not turn any test red.
scenarios: A steady-state tick where the review-bot is already at $TARGET (no bot delta) but a prior failure left the bot-backoff window open
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a case mirroring test_bot_backoff_tick... but with the git stub reporting no BOT_PATHS/SECRETS_PATHS change; assert 'backoff active' is ABSENT and the deployed-sha advances (footer reached).

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the footer against stamping MCP_SHA_FILE when the mcp block was skipped by an open backoff window with a pending delta (add an `mcp_incomplete` flag mirroring `bot_incomplete`, and exit/skip the mcp footer advance).
evidence: infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:714: `if ! mcp_backoff_active && changed_range "$mcp_deployed" "$TARGET" "$MCP_PATHS"; then` — mcp block is SKIPPED when backoff is active, and MCP_SHA_FILE is only advanced INSIDE that block (line 807)
infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:821: `if [ "$bot_deferred" = 1 ] || [ "$bot_incomplete" = 1 ]; then` — guard only exits for BOT deferral/incompleteness; a bot that deployed or had no work leaves both 0

infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:876: `echo "$TARGET" > "$MCP_SHA_FILE.tmp" && mv "$MCP_SHA_FILE.tmp" "$MCP_SHA_FILE"` — unconditionally stamps mcp as deployed even when mcp was skipped by its open backoff window
search_files mcp_incomplete -> (no matches): no analogous incompleteness flag exists for the mcp path
infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:879: `clear_mcp_backoff` runs unconditionally at the success footer
infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:711: mcp block skipped (not deployed) when `mcp_backoff_active` — clearing its backoff at the footer removes the throttle for a component that did not complete
blocking.finding: When the mcp backoff window is open with a real pending mcp delta, the mcp block is skipped but the success footer unconditionally re-stamps MCP_SHA_FILE=$TARGET (line 876), so the next tick computes no mcp delta and permanently drops the pending mcp change. This is the exact `bot_incomplete` defect the fourth round fixed for the bot, left unfixed for mcp — there is no `mcp_incomplete` guard.
merged_from: On a tick where the mcp backoff window is open with a pending delta but the footer is reached (bot deployed/no work), `clear_mcp_backoff` at line 879 runs, erasing the mcp backoff throttle even though the mcp deploy was skipped and never succeeded.
scenarios: mcp deploy fails once (opens mcp backoff), then a subsequent tick has a shared src/rebar delta where the bot deploys successfully (bot idle) but the mcp backoff window is still open — footer stamps mcp-deployed-sha=$TARGET, and the pending mcp fix is dropped until a NEW target lands
blocking.suggested_fix: Introduce `mcp_incomplete=1` in the `mcp_backoff_active && changed_range ...` branch (lines 711-713) and include it in the footer guard at 821 (or make the line 876 MCP_SHA_FILE advance and the 879 clear_mcp_backoff conditional on `mcp_incomplete != 1`), exactly as bot_incomplete is handled.

blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 157 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug cf34-9b8b-1aa7-4d95 has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix like this is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan cf34-9b8b-1aa7-4d95` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review cf34-9b8b-1aa7-4d95` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan cf34-9b8b-1aa7-4d95 --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.
